3240-6462-7272-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
3240-6462-7272-8347.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Sela triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2557-5742-5743-8242.description:
Activate Songbird by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Songbird ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2169-4659-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-4659-4694-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2350-2981-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2350-2981-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stone Calendar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

1479-2841-6156-7893.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-6156-7893.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1477-7690-7810--165.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing an artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
Repeat.

2811-4399-4518-5998.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Elas il-Kor trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2811-4399-4518-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

884-3179-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Ayara trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
884-3179-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3908-4264.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3908-4264.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Spark Double each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3908-4264.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

129-1409-6723-7175.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-5614-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-5614-6968.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

933-2724-6432.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Conjurer's Closet. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

240-2511-4460-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-6441-7329.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-6662-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

5310-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodghast
When Bloodghast dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning Bloodghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

862-2921-4053-6989.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

373-877-2908.description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {0}.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

56-4556-5256-6887.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-4556-5256-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Blight Mound and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-4556-5256-6887.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

104-4186-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4186-6719.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1497-3327-4613-4802.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1497-3327-4613-4802.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1115-1256-1270-5477.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

339-677-2506.description:
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, casting Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters the abttlefield, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a token copy of Jegantha with haste.
Put the nontoken Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate the token Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, casting Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Put the token Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-3490-4659-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1274-3490-4659-6458.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4659-6458.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

943-3664-4235-4552.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by tapping it, targeting Lotus Field.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Deserted Temple.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping Deserted Temple and Lotus Field
Repeat
943-3664-4235-4552.notes: Once you have excess mana, you can untap other lands instead of [Land that Taps to Add Multiple Mana]].

2584-2942-3059.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to three times Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

371-4068-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Forests, and at least one Mountain.
371-4068-5003.description:
Activate five Forests by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Llanowar Druid by tapping and sacrificing it.
Llanowar Druid dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Llanowar Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Llanowar Druid ability from step 2, untapping all Forests.
Repeat.

1379-3576-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Vedalken Engineer.
Vedalken Engineer does not have summoning sickness.
1379-3576-4222.description:
Activate Vedalken Engineer by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Vedalken Engineer.
Repeat.

473-1017-1242-1656.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
473-1017-1242-1656.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Archivist's ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using CInderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

2835-3944-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing itself, adding {B}.
Blood Pet dies, triggering Fecundity and Mortuary.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw Blood Pet.
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
Repeat.

170-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
170-3490-4659.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Woodland Champion.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Woodland Champion trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1806-2034-4646.notablePrerequisites: Curse of Clinging Webs attached to yourself.
1806-2034-4646.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Curse of Clinging Webs triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge and creating a 1/2 Spider token with reach.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spider token, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

2034-2757-5200-5251.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Emmara, Soul of the Accord.
At least 1 basic land under your control.
2034-2757-5200-5251.description:
Activate Earthcraft to tap Emmara, Soul of the Accord and untap a basic land.
Tap the land for mana.
Emmara, Soul of the Accord triggers creating a token creature.
Activate Earthcraft to tap the token creature to untap a basic land.
Tap the land for mana.
Sacrifice the token creature to Ashnod's Altar floating {2}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns to untap Emmara, Soul of the Accord.
Repeat.
